Studied: Acrobatics.name: Studied: Acrobatics
Studied: Acrobatics.description:
🤸 You trained in gymnastics, trampoline, dance or a circus school, and you know how to tumble, balance and land.

🌱 Flips, handsprings, balance on narrow surfaces and breakfalls. Knocked off a ledge, you turn and land instead of crashing.
⚠️ Great heights, landing with a passenger and aerial moves in the middle of a fight are still dangerous.
⚖️ It is no professional certification, and stunts on public structures still draw police warnings.
🏫 It shows in your posture, your flexibility and the reflex to tuck and roll.

📈 Grants: Acrobatics +15
Studied: Acrobatics.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has trained in acrobatics: flips, handsprings, balance on narrow surfaces, twists in midair and breakfalls that spread an impact across the body. Thrown or knocked off a ledge, they turn and land instead of crashing. Prior study, not mastery: falls from a great height, landing with a passenger and aerial work in the middle of a fight are still dangerous. Not a license: it is no professional certification, and stunts on public structures still draw police warnings. It shows in posture, flexibility and the reflex to tuck and roll.
